Hi all — quick triage update from infra: we observed a correlated increase in kernel swap/queueing on the pool serving citrine-3b around 07:40 PT; the spike aligns with a surge of long-context streaming requests from a handful of heavy keys. Symptoms: out-of-memory backpressure that progressed to transient 500s and client timeouts.

Mitigations applied (09:20 PT):
- Enabled temporary per-key concurrency limit for the citrine-3b pool to curb tail-loads.
- Added automatic fallback routing for your account to citrine-3b-q4 (quantized variant) with identical API semantics for up to 60s while we stabilize.
- Warmed KV cache by preloading common prefixes seen in your logs.
- Rolling restart of two workers that showed degraded GPU memory reclamation.

Preliminary impact: 500 rate fell from ~15% to ~1.2% over 25 minutes; timeouts reduced to sub-1% after fallback routing. We'll monitor 2 hours and then revert changes if stable.

Next steps: Marcus will pull heap/GPU telemetry and a short syscall trace for the restarted workers; we'll produce a formal postmortem and RCA in 48 hours.

Ben

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Citrine3B generate: intermittent 500s/timeouts

Adding the technical summary we pulled and a short log excerpt:

- Root cause (preliminary): a regression in the attention-kernel scheduler introduced in the 2026-11 runtime roll that caused delayed KV-cache eviction when streams held open long contexts (>> 4096 tokens). Over time the worker's GPU memory footprint drifted up and the allocator hit a threshold that returned 500s.
- Why it affected Concordia: your usage pattern includes parallel long streaming sessions which amplified the memory-drift effect.
- Why the quantized variant helped: citrine-3b-q4 has a different memory path and smaller per-sequence working set, so fallback successfully avoided pressure on the affected allocator path.

Attached: short kernel trace and the restart timeline (we included the incident log you sent plus our trace). We'll compile a full RCA and mitigation plan.

—Marcus

- Runtime patch deployed to all citrine-3b pools (2026-12-12 02:00 PT) — mitigates delayed eviction.
